tasks.title: HANGS General Contracting · 2026 Forms 1099-NEC
tasks.description: Prepare the 2026 Forms 1099-NEC for HANGS General Contracting from 6 Excel, PDF, Word and email documents. Sort every vendor payment by W-9 status and classification: corporations, merchandise and card charges left out, the 2026 $2,000 threshold applied, the law firm’s fees reported, and backup withholding worked out for the vendor with no TIN. Tie the forms to the payments and the accounts payable ledger. Produce formula-linked Excel workpapers and supported figures on an incomplete draft. Open items stay open for a person. This demo plays back one recorded run; the run’s real working time is shown at the end.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with evidence tabs, and an incomplete draft Forms 1099-NEC PDF with evidence trails and original source attachments
tasks.gates: Incomplete draft, not reviewed or filed. Missing evidence and differences stay open. A person reviews and files.
steps: Find the Vendors and Their W-9s
